words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍
words.ex: He lives in the hall of residence near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A hall of residence is a building where students live at a university or college.

words.ex: The student hostel is near the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生宿舍在图书馆附近。
words.en: A student hostel is a place where students live while they are studying at a university or college. It usually offers basic accommodation at a lower cost than private housing.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: He lives in a small studio apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小单间公寓里。
words.en: A studio apartment is a small apartment which combines living room, bedroom, and kitchen into a single room.

words.tr: adj. 带有私人浴室的；套房的
words.ex: The room has an en-suite bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一个内嵌浴室。
words.en: An adjective describing a room or facility that is directly connected to and for the private use of a bedroom, especially in a hotel or house.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里很吵。
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区；
words.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。
words.en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr: phrase. 房主；房屋所有者；业主
words.ex: The owner of the house decided to renovate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 房屋所有权人决定翻新厨房。
words.en: A person who legally possesses and has the right to occupy or control a dwelling or building.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: The landlady gives us the keys every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 女房东每周一给我们钥匙。
words.en: A woman who rents out land, a building, or accommodation.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: He lives in a rural area with few shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在几乎没有商店的乡村地区。
words.en: A rural area is an area of countryside, as opposed to a town or city.

words.ex: He walks to the city centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去市中心。
words.en: The central part of a city, where there are often many shops, businesses, and cultural attractions.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: The children are playing in the main hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在主厅里玩耍。
words.en: The principal or largest room in a building, used for gatherings or events.

words.ex: The children are waiting in the entrance hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在入口大厅里等待。
words.en: An entrance hall is a large room or area at the entrance of a building.

words.ex: We eat lunch in the dining hall.
words.ex_cn: 我们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A dining hall is a large room in a institution where meals are served to a large number of people.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在市政厅举行。
words.en: A town hall is a building used for the administration of local government, or a meeting at which a public official or political candidate addresses an audience.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: He booked a single room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了一个单人房间过夜。
words.en: A single room is a hotel room designed for one person, containing one single bed.

words.tr: phrase. 带两张单人床的双人房
words.ex: We booked a twin room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room with two single beds, typically for two people.

words.ex: We booked a double room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room intended for two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.tr: phrase. 三人间（可供三人入住的房间）
words.ex: We booked a triple room for our family trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为家庭旅行预订了一个三人间。
words.en: A room that is designed to accommodate three people, typically equipped with three beds.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；“furnish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 配备家具的；
words.ex: They furnished the apartment with new tables and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他们给公寓布置了新的桌椅。
words.en: If a room or building is furnished, it is equipped with furniture.

words.tr:
adj. 无装备的；无家具设备的
v. 搬走家具；“unfurnish”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The apartment is unfurnished.
words.ex_cn: 这个公寓没有家具。
words.en: If a room or house is unfurnished, it does not contain any furniture.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: She washed the bed sheet yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天洗了床单。
words.en: A bed sheet is a large piece of cloth used to cover a mattress, often used in pairs with one sheet below the sleeper and one sheet above.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: He heats food in a microwave oven.
words.ex_cn: 他用微波炉加热食物。
words.en: A microwave oven is an oven that uses microwaves to cook or heat food.

words.ex: He uses a toaster to make toast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用烤面包机烤面包。
words.en: A toaster is an electric device for making toast by heating slices of bread on both sides.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: The heater keeps the room warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个加热器在冬天让房间保持温暖。
words.en: A device used to generate heat for warming a space or water.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: He left the house through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 他从后门离开了房子。
words.en: A back door is a door at the back of a building, or a way of achieving something secretly or unofficially.

words.ex: I need to buy a new water heater.
words.ex_cn: 我需要买一个新的热水器。
words.en: A device that heats water for use in homes and businesses.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: He used a fire blanket to put out the small flame.
words.ex_cn: 他用灭火毯扑灭了小火。
words.en: A fire blanket is a safety device made of fire-resistant material and designed to extinguish small fires.

words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 深夜里，火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: A device that makes a loud noise to warn people of a fire.

words.ex: He turned on the air conditioner to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了空调来让房间凉快。
words.en: An air conditioner is a machine that keeps the air in a building cool and dry.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr: phrase. 水费账单；用水费用单据
words.ex: He paid the water bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了水费。
words.en: A water bill is a statement of charges for water usage that is sent to a customer by a water utility company.

words.ex: He paid the electricity bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了电费。
words.en: A bill for the amount of electricity used in a particular period, typically sent monthly.

words.tr: phrase. 煤气费账单；燃气费用
words.ex: He paid his gas bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天付了燃气费。
words.en: A gas bill is a statement of charges for gas services provided to a household or business, typically issued monthly by the gas company.

words.ex: He paid his phone bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天付了电话账单。
words.en: A phone bill is a statement of charges for telephone services, which is sent to a customer regularly, usually monthly.

words.tr: phrase. 网络费用账单；互联网服务费
words.ex: I paid my internet bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了网络账单。
words.en: A statement of money owed for internet services provided.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He paid with a cheque yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天用支票付款了。
words.en: A written order to a bank to pay a specified sum from someone's account.

words.tr: phrase. 银行间的转帐； 银行汇款
words.ex: He made a bank transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过银行转账支付了房租。
words.en: A bank transfer is a method of transferring money from one bank account to another.

words.tr: phrase. 在线转账；网络汇款
words.ex: He made an online transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在线转账支付了房租。
words.en: The process of moving funds from one account to another via the internet.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 自助游；自行安排的旅游
words.ex: We took a self-service tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们自己参观了博物馆。
words.en: A tour where participants guide themselves without a tour leader.

words.ex: We booked a package tour to Japan last month.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个月预订了一次去日本的跟团旅行。
words.en: A package tour is a holiday organized by a travel agent, with arrangements for transport, accommodation, and sometimes meals and entertainment, all included in the price.

words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.ex: The tourist industry brings money to the small town.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为这个小镇带来了收入。
words.en: The sector of the economy devoted to the business of providing services to tourists, including accommodation, travel, and entertainment.

words.ex: They go on ecotourism to protect nature.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行生态旅游以保护自然。
words.en: Ecotourism is a form of tourism involving visiting fragile, pristine, and relatively undisturbed natural areas, intended as a low-impact and often small scale alternative to standard commercial mass tourism.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: He made a seat reservation for the train.
words.ex_cn: 他为火车订了座位。
words.en: The act of reserving a seat in advance for an event or journey.

words.tr: n. 预订； v. 预订；“book”的现在分词；
words.ex: I made a booking for a hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了一间酒店房间。
words.en: The act of reserving accommodations, travel arrangements, tickets, etc., in advance.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr: n. 取消；撤销；作废；中止；
words.ex: The flight cancellation made us wait for a new ticket.
words.ex_cn: 航班取消让我们不得不等待新的机票。
words.en: The act of cancelling something; a situation in which something that has been arranged is stopped from happening.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.tr: phrase. 交通信号灯；红绿灯
words.ex: The car stopped at the traffic lights.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交通信号灯前停了下来。
words.en: A set of automatically operated coloured lights, typically red, amber, and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: The flight number is 234.
words.ex_cn: 航班号是234。
words.en: A flight number is the specific code assigned to a particular flight by an airline, consisting of the airline's code followed by a numerical identifier.

words.tr: phrase. 登机牌；用于登机时的身份凭证
words.ex: He showed his boarding pass at the gate.
words.ex_cn: 他在登机口出示了登机牌。
words.en: A boarding pass is a document provided by an airline during check-in, giving a passenger permission to board the airplane for a particular flight.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.tr: phrase. 一流的；头等舱；第一类邮件；第一堂课
words.ex: He got a first class result in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了一流的成绩。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as first class, you mean that they are extremely good and of the highest quality.

words.ex: He flew in business class to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐商务舱飞行以节省时间。
words.en: Business class refers to a high-quality travel class available on some airlines and rail lines, offering more comfortable seating, better food, and more amenities than economy class.

words.ex: He booked an economy class ticket for the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他为航班预订了经济舱机票。
words.en: Economy class is the cheapest type of seats in a plane or train.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He takes the underground railway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway is a railway system in which the trains run in tunnels below the ground, especially in a city.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: He parked his car in the underground car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在地下停车场。
words.en: An underground car park is a parking facility located below ground level, often beneath a building or public space, designed to accommodate vehicles.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: He drives a car with four-wheel drive.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆四轮驱动的车。
words.en: A four-wheel drive is a vehicle that is capable of transmitting power to all four wheels simultaneously, providing better traction especially on slippery or uneven surfaces.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.ex: I took a taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi is a car driven by someone whose job is to take people where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 公交系统；公共汽车系统
words.ex: The bus system in this city is very slow.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的公交系统非常慢。
words.en: A bus system refers to the network of buses that operate within a city or region, providing public transportation services to its residents.

words.ex: The bus route goes past my house.
words.ex_cn: 这条公交路线经过我家。
words.en: A bus route is the path or course that a bus follows regularly, often including a series of stops.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.ex: The student hostel is near the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生宿舍在图书馆附近。
words.en: A student hostel is a place where students live while they are studying at a university or college. It usually offers basic accommodation at a lower cost than private housing.

words.ex: The students stayed in a youth hostel during their trip.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在旅行期间住在青年旅舍。
words.en: A youth hostel is a place where young people, especially those who are traveling, can stay cheaply for short periods of time. It usually provides dormitory-style accommodation and shared facilities.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.ex: We rented a holiday house by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们租了一栋海边的度假屋。
words.en: A holiday house is a dwelling, often in a vacation area, where people stay during their holidays.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: He got his driving license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving license is an official document which shows that you have passed the necessary tests and are allowed to drive a vehicle.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The restaurant added a service charge to the bill.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅在账单上加了一笔服务费。
words.en: A service charge is an amount of money that is added to your bill in a restaurant or hotel, to pay for the service you have received.

words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.ex: There is an extra charge for late payment.
words.ex_cn: 迟交款项会收取额外费用。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid for a service or product beyond the standard or advertised price.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: He used a traveler's check to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用旅行支票买了食物。
words.en: A traveler's check is a medium of exchange that can be used in place of hard currency. They are often used by people on vacation in foreign countries.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.ex: He uses a flashlight to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A flashlight is a small portable electric light that is powered by batteries and typically has a handle for holding.

words.ex: He wears sunglasses on sunny days.
words.ex_cn: 他在晴天戴太阳镜。
words.en: Sunglasses are glasses with dark lenses which you wear to protect your eyes from bright sunlight.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: He bought new walking boots for the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他为远足买了新的1058型徒步靴。
words.en: Walking boots are sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances, typically used for hiking or trekking.

words.ex: He wore hiking boots to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了登山靴去爬山。
words.en: Hiking boots are sturdy footwear designed for long walks in the countryside, especially on rough or uneven ground.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: He puts on sun cream before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂上防晒霜。
words.en: A cream or lotion applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays.

words.ex: He puts on sun lotion before going to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩前涂上防晒霜。
words.en: A lotion or cream spread on the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.tr: phrase. 如画的风景；优美如画的景色
words.ex: The village has picturesque scenery with mountains and lakes.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有着如画的风景，有山有湖。
words.en: Scenery that is visually attractive and charming, often in a rural or natural setting.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 历史兴趣；历史价值
words.ex: The old house has historical interest because it was built in 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子具有历史价值，因为它建于1800年。
words.en: Historical interest refers to the curiosity or concern about the past, including events, people, and cultures.

words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.ex: We visited a scenic spot near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们参观了山附近的一个风景点。
words.en: A scenic spot refers to a place of interest or a tourist attraction known for its natural beauty or cultural significance.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: We visited the American Museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了美国博物馆。
words.en: An institution dedicated to preserving and exhibiting artifacts, artworks, or historical items related to the United States.

words.ex: I visited the Great Britain Museum last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周参观了大英博物馆。

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.tr: phrase. 伦敦塔（英国伦敦一座历史悠久的城堡，曾用作皇宫、监狱和宝库）
words.ex: The tourists visited the Tower of London.
words.ex_cn: 游客们参观了伦敦塔。
words.en: The Tower of London is a historic castle on the north bank of the River Thames in central London. It was founded towards the end of 1066 as part of the Norman Conquest of England. The White Tower, which gives the entire castle its name, was built by William the Conqueror in 1078 and was a resented symbol of oppression, inflicted upon London by the new ruling elite.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: The wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: Wetlands are areas where water covers the soil, or is present either at or near the surface of the soil all year or for varying periods of time during the year, including during the growing season.

words.ex: The birds live in the marshland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟住在河边的沼泽地里。
words.en: Marshland refers to an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 纪念品商店；售卖纪念品的店铺
words.ex: He bought a keychain from a souvenir shop.
words.ex_cn: 他从一家纪念品商店买了一个钥匙扣。
words.en: A souvenir shop is a store where souvenirs and other memorabilia are sold, typically located in tourist areas.

words.ex: She bought a souvenir at the gift shop.
words.ex_cn: 她在礼品店买了一件纪念品。
words.en: A gift shop is a retail store that sells items that are suitable for giving as presents, such as souvenirs, knickknacks, and other small items.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.ex: The footbridge connects the two sides of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座人行桥连接了河的两岸。
words.en: A footbridge is a narrow bridge for pedestrians.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.tr: n. 露营； v. “camp”的现在分词；
words.ex: Camping in the mountains is fun.
words.ex_cn: 在山上露营很有趣。
words.en: Camping is the activity of staying in a tent on holiday.

words.tr: n. 远足；徒步旅行； v. 增加；“hike”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves hiking in the mountains on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里远足。
words.en: Hiking is the activity of going for long walks in the countryside for pleasure.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动； v. 冲浪；“surf”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves surfing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末冲浪。
words.en: Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

words.tr: n. 驾驶； v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的现在分词； adj. 强有力的；推动的；
words.ex: Driving is his favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 驾驶是他最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of controlling and steering a vehicle.

words.tr: v. 以快而平稳的速度长距离行驶； adj. 乘船巡游( cruise的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The car was cruising down the highway at 100 km/h.
words.ex_cn: 汽车以每小时100公里的快而平稳的速度在高速公路上行驶。
words.en: Travelling by boat for pleasure, often over long distances.

words.ex: He enjoys bushwalking in the national park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在国家公园里徒步穿越丛林。
words.en: Bushwalking is the activity of walking in the bush or countryside, especially in Australia.

words.tr: phrase. 观鸟；观察野生鸟类的活动
words.ex: He enjoys bird watching in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喜欢在公园观鸟。
words.en: The activity of observing birds in their natural habitat as a hobby.

words.ex: He enjoys horse riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for pleasure or sport.

words.tr: n. 洞穴探索；“cave”的现在分词
words.ex: He loves caving in the mountains during weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山里进行洞穴探索。
words.en: The activity of exploring caves, especially as a hobby or sport.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr: 短语动词. 探索洞穴
words.ex: They decided to explore caves during their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定在假期期间探索洞穴。
words.en: To investigate or travel through caves for discovery or adventure.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.ex: They went to a music festival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末去参加了一个音乐节。
words.en: A music festival is a festival oriented towards music that is sometimes presented with a theme such as musical genre, nationality or locality of musicians, or holiday.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术节；美术节；艺术庆典
words.ex: The town holds an art festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天举办艺术节。
words.en: An event or celebration that showcases various forms of art, such as paintings, sculptures, performances, etc., often held in a specific location for a period of time.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.tr: 短语. 在远处；不亲近地；保持距离地
words.ex: The two dogs barked at a distance from each other.
words.ex_cn: 两只狗隔着一段距离互相吠叫。
words.en: If something is at a distance, it is far away from you.

words.tr: 短语. 从远处；在远处
words.ex: She waved to him from a distance.
words.ex_cn: 她远远地向他挥手。
words.en: If you look at something from a distance, you are looking at it from a place that is far away from it, so that you cannot see it very clearly.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.ex: The bank is on your left.
words.ex_cn: 银行在你的左边。
words.en: Positioned to the left side of a person or reference point.

words.ex: The book is to my left.
words.ex_cn: 书在我左边。
words.en: Located on the left side of someone or something.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的右侧；在某人的右边
words.ex: The bank is on your right.
words.ex_cn: 银行在你的右边。
words.en: Positioned to the right side of a person or reference point.

words.ex: The book is to my right.
words.ex_cn: 书在我右边。
words.en: on the right-hand side of someone or something

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.ex: The northern wind is cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的北风很冷。
words.en: Northern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the north.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.ex: The eastern city has many old temples.
words.ex_cn: 东部的城市有许多古老的寺庙。
words.en: Eastern means in or from the east part of an area.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: The signpost shows the way to the village.
words.ex_cn: 路标指示了去村庄的路。
words.en: A signpost is a post with a sign on it, giving information such as the direction to a place or the distance to it.

words.ex: The hunter shot an arrow at the target.
words.ex_cn: 猎人向目标射了一支箭。
words.en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. Arrows are shot from a bow.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.ex: We go across the street every morning to buy bread.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上过街去买面包。
words.en: To move from one side to the other of something such as a river, road, or border.

words.ex: The car stopped at a crossroad.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A crossroad is a place where two roads meet and cross each other, or a point at which an important decision must be made.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.tr: n. 丁字路口；T字形接合处
words.ex: The car stopped at the t-junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在T形路口停了下来。
words.en: A T-junction is a place where one road joins another but does not cross it, forming the shape of the letter T.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: Please use the pedestrian walk to cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 请使用人行道过马路。

words.ex: He walks on the sidewalk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在人行道上走路。
words.en: A sidewalk is a path with a hard surface by the side of a road that people walk on.

words.tr: phrase. 斑马线：一种由一系列宽阔的白色条纹标记的人行横道，用于指示行人有优先通行权的过街点。
words.ex: The children walk across the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们走过斑马线。
words.en: A zebra crossing is a place on the road that is marked with broad black and white stripes, where vehicles must stop to allow pedestrians to cross.

words.tr: phrase. 行人过街道：一个标记的路径，人们可以安全地穿过街道或道路。
words.ex: The child waited at the pedestrian crossing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在人行横道处等待。
words.en: A pedestrian crossing is a designated point on a road at which pedestrians are permitted to cross safely.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的后面；位于……的背部或后方
words.ex: The cat is at the back of the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫在房间的后面。
words.en: Located directly behind something.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.ex: Her views are completely opposite to mine.
words.ex_cn: 她的观点与我的完全相反。
words.en: To be completely different from something else in nature or direction.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The house is adjacent to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子紧挨着公园。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or very near it.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；在…周围；在邻近地区
words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校附近。
words.en: in the area near a particular place

words.ex: The school is in the proximity of the park.
words.ex_cn: 学校在公园附近。

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: He wants to open an account at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想在银行开一个账户。
words.en: To open an account means to establish a new account with a bank or other financial institution where money can be deposited, withdrawn, or managed.

words.ex: He puts money into his savings account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周把钱存入他的储蓄账户。
words.en: A savings account is a bank account where you can deposit money that you do not need immediately and earn interest on it.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 定期存款账户；储蓄存款账户
words.ex: He put his savings into a deposit account.
words.ex_cn: 他把积蓄存入了一个定期存款账户。
words.en: A deposit account is a bank account that earns interest and allows you to deposit and withdraw money, but typically does not come with a checkbook or debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 选择账户；挑选账号
words.ex: You must select account before you can log in.
words.ex_cn: 你必须选择账户才能登录。
words.en: Choose a specific account from available options.

words.tr: phrase. 两人共有的银行账户；联合账户
words.ex: They have a joint account for their rent and groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个共同账户用于支付房租和杂货。
words.en: A joint account is a bank account shared by two or more individuals, typically used for managing shared expenses or assets.

words.tr: phrase. 即时账户；可立即开通并使用的账户
words.ex: He opened an instant account online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线上开设了一个即时账户。
words.en: An instant account is a type of bank account that can be opened quickly, often online, and allows for immediate use without the need for a lengthy application process.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.tr: v. 透支；过度往后拉；过分描述
words.ex: He overdraws his bank account every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都透支银行账户。
words.en: To overdraw means to withdraw more money from a bank account than the account holds, resulting in a negative balance. It can also mean to exaggerate or embellish in description or representation.

words.ex: He went overdrawn on his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他的银行账户透支了。
words.en: An overdraft occurs when money is withdrawn from a bank account and the available balance goes below zero.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: He exceeded his credit limit and was charged a fee.
words.ex_cn: 他超过了信用额度，因此被收取了费用。
words.en: The maximum amount of credit that a financial institution or other lender will extend to a debtor for a particular line of credit (or for a credit card).

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He sent the payment by money order.
words.ex_cn: 他通过汇票支付了款项。
words.en: A money order is a printed order for payment of a specified sum, issued by a bank or post office.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网服务；网络接入服务；在线服务
words.ex: He pays for internet service every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都支付网络服务费用。
words.en: Internet service refers to the provision of internet access to users by an internet service provider (ISP).

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The restaurant added a service charge to the bill.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅在账单上加了一笔服务费。
words.en: A service charge is an amount of money that is added to your bill in a restaurant or hotel, to pay for the service you have received.

words.tr: phrase. 服务费；入场费（餐厅或酒吧对顾客收取的强制性费用，通常用于覆盖服务或设施成本）
words.ex: The bar has a cover charge of $10 on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这个酒吧在周末收取10美元的入场费。
words.en: A fee paid for entry to a venue, such as a nightclub or restaurant, often in addition to the cost of food or drink.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.ex: The bank raised the interest rate last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The interest rate is the percentage of an amount of money which is paid for its use for a specified time, usually expressed as an annual percentage rate.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 处于借用状态；被借出；在租借期间
words.ex: The book is on loan to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 这本书借给了我的朋友。
words.en: To be temporarily given to someone else for use, especially in the context of books, artworks, or employees.

words.tr: phrase. 低息贷款；利率较低的贷款
words.ex: He got a low-interest loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一笔低息贷款来买一辆车。
words.en: A loan offered at a rate of interest that is below the average market rate.

words.tr: phrase. 无息贷款；不收取利息的借款
words.ex: The bank offered a no-interest loan to help small businesses during the pandemic.
words.ex_cn: 银行为帮助小企业在疫情期间提供了一笔无息贷款。
words.en: A loan that does not require the borrower to pay interest on the principal amount.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上发现了一便士。
words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.ex: He paid one dollar for the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一美元买这个苹果。
words.en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the United States, Canada, Australia, and some other countries.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.ex: He paid five euros for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五欧元买咖啡。
words.en: The euro is the official currency of the Eurozone, which consists of 19 of the 27 member states of the European Union.

words.tr: n. 讲述者；（银行）出纳员；
words.ex: The old man is the teller of fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是童话故事的讲述者。
words.en: A teller is a person who works in a bank and whose job includes receiving and paying out money.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 住在校园内；在校内住宿
words.ex: He lives on campus with his roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和室友住在校园里。
words.en: To reside within the premises of an educational institution, typically a college or university, for the duration of one's studies.

words.tr: phrase. 住在校外；不在学校宿舍居住
words.ex: He lives off campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园外，靠近公交站。
words.en: To reside in a place that is not part of the university or college campus.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: We eat lunch in the dining hall.
words.ex_cn: 我们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A dining hall is a large room in a institution where meals are served to a large number of people.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.ex: The students eat lunch in the refectory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A refectory is a dining hall, especially in a monastery, college, or other institution.

words.ex: The students relax in the common room after class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们下课后在公共休息室休息。
words.en: A common room is a room in a school, college, or university where students can relax and socialize.

words.tr: n. 厕所；洗手间；休息室；更衣室
words.ex: He went to the restroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后去了洗手间。
words.en: A restroom is a room in a public building with toilets and sinks for people to use.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: The main building is where the classrooms are.
words.ex_cn: 主楼是教室所在的地方。
words.en: The principal or largest building of a complex, such as a university, hospital, or business.

words.ex: The children are playing in the main hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在主厅里玩耍。
words.en: The principal or largest room in a building, used for gatherings or events.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: We met in the conference room to talk.
words.ex_cn: 我们在会议室里开会讨论。
words.en: A room designated for meetings or conferences, typically equipped with facilities such as a large table, chairs, and presentation equipment.

words.ex: The students went to the lecture room at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 学生们早上九点去了教室。
words.en: A room in a school or university where lectures, especially large ones, are delivered.

words.ex: The students went to the lecture theatre for biology class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去讲堂上生物课。
words.en: A large room or hall used for lectures, typically with tiered seating for the audience.

words.ex: The students walk to the teaching building every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每天早上步行去教学楼。
words.en: A building used for teaching and learning activities in educational institutions.

words.ex: The administrating office handles all the school paperwork.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室处理学校所有的文书工作。
words.en: An administrating office is a department or division within an organization that is responsible for managing and overseeing the organization's operations and administrative tasks.

words.ex: The teachers are having a meeting in the faculty room.
words.ex_cn: 老师们正在教员休息室开会。
words.en: A room reserved for the use of faculty members in a school or university.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.ex: The lavatory is down the hall.
words.ex_cn: 洗手间在走廊尽头。
words.en: A lavatory is a room equipped with a toilet and sink for washing hands and face.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: He went to the washroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后去了洗手间。
words.en: A room with facilities for washing and usually also toilet facilities; a bathroom.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: phrase. 语言中心；语言中枢（大脑中负责语言理解与产生的区域）
words.ex: He goes to the language centre every Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周二去语言中心。
words.en: A language centre is an institution or facility that provides language learning and teaching services.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机实验室；电脑实验室，用于进行计算机相关教学、实验或研究的专用房间或场所
words.ex: The students use the computer laboratory for their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在计算机实验室做作业。
words.en: A room or building equipped with computers and other electronic devices for educational or research purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 卫生保健；健康护理
words.ex: He works in health care as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士从事医疗工作。
words.en: Health care refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: He went to the medical centre for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去医疗中心做检查。
words.en: A medical centre is a building or group of buildings where medical services are provided to the public.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: The players go to the locker room after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球员们去更衣室。
words.en: A locker room is a room, especially in a sports facility, where people can change their clothes and store their belongings in lockers.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询中心；辅导中心（提供心理、职业或教育等方面咨询服务的机构）
words.ex: The university has established a counselling centre to support students' mental health.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学设立了一个咨询中心来支持学生的心理健康。
words.en: A place where professional advice and support are provided to individuals who need help with personal, social, or psychological problems.

words.ex: He went to the career advice centre to find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业咨询中心找一份好工作。
words.en: A place where individuals can receive guidance and support regarding their career choices and job searching strategies.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: phrase. 体育运动中心；体育馆
words.ex: He goes to the sports centre every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都去体育中心。
words.en: A sports centre is a facility where people can participate in various sports and physical activities.

words.ex: We played chess indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们在室内下棋。
words.en: Located, done, or used inside a building.

words.tr: phrase. 室内竞技场；室内体育馆
words.ex: The basketball game was held in an indoor arena.
words.ex_cn: 篮球比赛在室内体育馆举行。
words.en: An enclosed sports or event venue, often with a roof, designed for activities like basketball, concerts, or exhibitions.

words.tr: phrase. 室内体育场；室内体育馆
words.ex: The game will be held in an indoor stadium.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛将在室内体育馆举行。
words.en: An indoor stadium is a large building for sports events and concerts, designed to be used inside, away from the weather.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 娱乐综合体；集休闲、娱乐、购物等功能于一体的大型设施
words.ex: The new entertainment complex has a movie theater and a restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 新的娱乐综合体有一家电影院和一家餐厅。
words.en: A large venue or complex designed for various forms of public entertainment.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
