words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.ex: I asked the school for a transcript of my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我向学校要了一份成绩单的副本。
words.en: A transcript is a written or printed version of something that has been recorded or spoken, especially in the context of academic records.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.tr: phrase. 注册参加；登记入学（某课程或项目）
words.ex: He will enrol in a math course next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将报名参加一门数学课程。
words.en: To officially join a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 注册；登记；报名参加（课程、活动等）
words.ex: Students need to register for their courses before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要在截止日期前注册他们的课程。
words.en: To officially sign up or enroll in a course, event, or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 有资格的；符合某事的条件
words.ex: He is eligible for a scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: To have the right to do or obtain something through satisfying the appropriate conditions.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr: phrase. 新生入学指导日；迎新日
words.ex: Students meet on orientation day to learn about the school.
words.ex_cn: 学生在迎新日认识学校。
words.en: An orientation day is a day set aside for welcoming and introducing new students or employees to an institution or organization, providing them with information about the environment, policies, and resources available to them.

words.ex: New students join orientation week to learn about the school.
words.ex_cn: 新生参加迎新周以了解学校。
words.en: A week at the beginning of a university term, during which a series of events are organized to introduce new students to the university and to help them settle in.

words.tr: phrase. 新生/新员工导向参观；熟悉环境的导览
words.ex: We took an orientation tour of the school on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周一参加了学校的迎新参观。
words.en: A guided tour designed to introduce newcomers to a new environment, such as a workplace, school, or city, highlighting key locations and facilities.

words.tr: phrase. 迎新介绍会；新生指导讲座
words.ex: The new students attended an orientation talk on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新生们在周一参加了迎新讲座。
words.en: A talk or meeting designed to introduce someone to a new environment, organization, or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 入学或旅游时收到的欢迎辞
words.ex: When we arrived at the hotel, we got a welcome package with a map and a note.
words.ex_cn: 当我们到达酒店时，收到了一份包含地图和便条的欢迎礼包。
words.en: A welcome package is a collection of items or information given to someone new to a place or organization, intended to make them feel welcome and to provide them with useful information or items.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr: phrase. 学生套装（通常指为学生设计的包含学习用品或优惠服务的组合包）
words.ex: The university offers a student pack that includes discounts on textbooks and software.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学提供了一个学生套餐，包含教科书和软件的折扣。
words.en: A set of materials or resources provided to a student for a particular course or program.

words.tr: phrase. 会议指南；会议资料册
words.ex: He received a conference pack with notes and a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一份包含笔记和一支笔的会议资料包。
words.en: A set of materials provided to attendees of a conference, typically including the agenda, speaker information, and other relevant documents.

words.tr: phrase. 包装材料；填充物；打包用的物料
words.ex: The box was filled with packing material.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装满了包装材料。
words.en: Material used to protect or cushion items during shipping or storage.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.ex: He took a placement test to join the advanced class.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次分班测试，以便进入高级班。
words.en: A placement test is a test usually given to a student entering an educational institution to determine the level of knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject or subjects.

words.ex: The camp had a test of leadership for the older kids.
words.ex_cn: 夏令营为大孩子们进行了一次领导力测试。
words.en: A situation or challenge that evaluates the effectiveness of a leader's abilities.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: He went to elementary school in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他曾在纽约上小学。
words.en: An elementary school is a school for children in their first few years of education, especially those between the ages of 5 and 11.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: He teaches math in a secondary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所中学教数学。
words.en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 18.

words.ex: He wants to go to higher education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后接受高等教育。
words.en: Higher education refers to the level of study that is undertaken at universities, colleges, and institutes of technology, beyond the level of secondary education.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: He lives in a boarding school far from home.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离家很远的寄宿学校。
words.en: A boarding school is a school where some or all pupils not only study but also live during term time, with their fellow students and possibly teachers.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: He pays tuition fee every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期支付学费。
words.en: A tuition fee is the amount of money that you have to pay for being taught in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: The living cost in the city is high.
words.ex_cn: 城市里的生活成本很高。
words.en: The amount of money needed to sustain a certain standard of living, including basics such as housing, food, taxes, and healthcare.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 无息贷款；不收取利息的借款
words.ex: The bank offered a no-interest loan to help small businesses during the pandemic.
words.ex_cn: 银行为帮助小企业在疫情期间提供了一笔无息贷款。
words.en: A loan that does not require the borrower to pay interest on the principal amount.

words.tr: phrase. 低息贷款；利率较低的贷款
words.ex: He got a low-interest loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一笔低息贷款来买一辆车。
words.en: A loan offered at a rate of interest that is below the average market rate.

words.tr: n. （大学）研究生助教奖学金
words.ex: He got an assistantship to help with research.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一份助教职位来协助研究。
words.en: An assistantship is a position of a graduate student that involves teaching or research duties in exchange for financial support.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He earned an undergraduate diploma in business.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工商专业的本科文凭。
words.en: An undergraduate diploma is a certificate awarded to students upon successful completion of a bachelor's degree program.

words.ex: He earned a postgraduate diploma in education.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了教育学研究生文凭。
words.en: A postgraduate diploma is a qualification awarded typically after a bachelor's degree, which is more advanced than a bachelor's degree but less so than a master's degree.

words.tr: phrase. 职业文凭；职业教育所颁发的资格证书
words.ex: He earned a vocational diploma in car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了汽车维修的职业文凭。
words.en: A vocational diploma is a certificate awarded to students who have completed a course of study in a specific trade or occupation, focusing on practical skills and knowledge required for the job.

words.tr: phrase. 副学士文凭；专科文凭（通常指完成两年制高等教育课程后获得的学位证书）
words.ex: He earned an associate diploma in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学的副学士学位。
words.en: A qualification awarded after completing a two-year course of study, typically at a college or technical institute.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor's degree in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了生物学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor's degree is an undergraduate academic degree awarded by colleges and universities upon completion of a course of study lasting three to seven years (depending on institution and academic discipline).

words.ex: He earned a master's degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工程学的硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an advanced academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.ex: He earned his doctor's degree in physics after five years of research.
words.ex_cn: 他经过五年的研究获得了物理学博士学位。
words.en: A doctor's degree is the highest level of academic degree awarded by universities, signifying the completion of advanced studies and research in a specific field.

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.ex: The student representative spoke at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 学生代表在会议上发言了。
words.en: A student representative is a student who is chosen or elected to represent the views of all the students in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: phrase. 本地学生；当地学生
words.ex: The local student walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这名本地学生每天步行上学。
words.en: A student who is from or lives in the area near the institution they attend, as opposed to an international or out-of-state student.

words.ex: The resident student lives on campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名住校学生住在校园里。
words.en: A student who lives in the school or college dormitory.

words.tr: phrase. 本国学生；国内学生（指在本国接受教育而非国际或外国学生）
words.ex: The domestic student lives on campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名本国学生住在校园里。
words.en: A student who is a citizen or permanent resident of the country where they are studying, as opposed to an international student.

words.ex: The overseas student lives in a dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位留学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student who comes from a foreign country to study in another country.

words.ex: The international student lives in the dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位国际学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student from a country other than the one in which they are studying.

words.tr: phrase. 转学生；从一所学校转到另一所学校就读的学生
words.ex: The transfer student quickly adapted to the new school environment.
words.ex_cn: 转学生迅速适应了新学校的环境。
words.en: A student who moves from one educational institution to another.

words.tr: phrase. 成年学生；指在成年后继续接受教育的学生
words.ex: The adult student works during the day and goes to class at night.
words.ex_cn: 这位成年学生白天工作，晚上上课。
words.en: An adult who is enrolled in an educational program, typically at a college or university, often balancing studies with other responsibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 成年学生（指年龄较大、通常已离校多年后再进入高等院校就读的人）
words.ex: He is a mature student who returned to university at age 35.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名35岁重返大学的成年学生。
words.en: A mature student is an adult who returns to education, typically after a period of time spent working or raising a family.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.tr: phrase. 一年级学生；大一新生
words.ex: He is a first-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一年级学生。
words.en: A first-year student is someone who is in their first year of study at a college or university.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.ex: He is a second-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A student in the second year of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr: phrase. 三年级学生；大学或学院的第三学年在读生
words.ex: He is a third-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的三年级学生。
words.en: A third-year student is someone who is in their third year of study at a college or university.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.tr: phrase. 大四学生；四年级学生
words.ex: He is a fourth-year student at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的四年级学生。
words.en: A student in their fourth year of study, typically at a college or university.

words.ex: He is a full-time student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名全日制学生。
words.en: A full-time student is someone who is enrolled in a post-secondary institution and is taking a minimum number of credit hours, typically 12 or more, per semester.

words.tr: phrase. 兼职学生；非全日制学生
words.ex: He is a part-time student who works in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名兼职学生，晚上工作。
words.en: A part-time student is someone who is enrolled in a course of study but does not attend classes full-time, often because they are working or have other commitments.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: He wants to major in biology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学主修生物学。
words.en: To specialize in a particular subject or field of study at a college or university.

words.tr: 专门研究，专攻；专门从事【动词短语】
words.ex: He specialises in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: This restaurant is famous for its specialty, fried dumplings.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅以特色菜煎饺而闻名。
words.en: A specialty is a particular area of study or expertise that someone has, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术学院；文艺学院
words.ex: He went to the school of arts to learn painting.
words.ex_cn: 他去艺术学院学习绘画。
words.en: A division or department within a university or college that offers courses and degrees in the arts, such as fine arts, music, drama, or literature.

words.ex: He works in the school of sciences at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的理学院工作。
words.en: A school of sciences is an institution or department within a university that focuses on the study and research of scientific disciplines.

words.ex: He is studying at the school of law.
words.ex_cn: 他正在法学院学习。
words.en: An institution where students study law at a university level.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The education department sends books to schools.
words.ex_cn: 教育部门向学校发送书籍。
words.en: The department of a government or organization responsible for the administration and oversight of education systems and policies.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.ex: Math is a required course for all freshmen.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有大一新生的必修课。
words.en: A required course is a course that students must take to complete their degree or program.

words.ex: He took a selective course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 他选了一门摄影选修课。
words.en: A course that students can choose to take as part of their studies, rather than a required course.

words.ex: She took an optional course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 她选了一门摄影的选修课。
words.en: An optional course is a class that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but it is not required for their degree.

words.tr: phrase. 模块化课程；由若干独立单元组成的课程
words.ex: He takes a modular course in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他修了一门模块化的计算机科学课程。
words.en: A modular course is a course of study that is divided into separate units or modules, each of which can be studied independently.

words.ex: He is taking an advanced course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门高级数学课程。
words.en: A course designed for students who already have a good understanding of the basic concepts and are ready to tackle more complex or specialized topics.

words.tr: phrase. 中级课程；中等水平课程
words.ex: He is taking an intermediate course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门中级数学课程。
words.en: A course of study or training that is between beginner and advanced levels.

words.tr: phrase. 初级课程；入门课程
words.ex: He signed up for a beginning course in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他报名参加了一个西班牙语入门课程。
words.en: An introductory or initial level of study or instruction in a particular subject or field.

words.ex: He is taking a basic course in math.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He loves learning local history in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢了解自己小镇的本地历史。
words.en: Local history refers to the historical study of a particular community, area, or region, often focusing on the people, events, and developments that have shaped its identity over time.

words.tr: phrase. 病史；病历；既往病史
words.ex: The doctor asked about his medical history.
words.ex_cn: 医生询问了他的病史。
words.en: A record of information about a person's health, including illnesses, treatments, and tests.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr: phrase. 历史兴趣；历史价值
words.ex: The old house has historical interest because it was built in 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子具有历史价值，因为它建于1800年。
words.en: Historical interest refers to the curiosity or concern about the past, including events, people, and cultures.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr: adj. 不损环境；利于环境
words.ex: She uses an environmental-friendly bag to shop.
words.ex_cn: 她用一个环保的袋子购物。
words.en: Designed or operating in a way that causes minimal harm to the environment.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr: phrase. 国际商务；跨国商业活动
words.ex: He works in international business.
words.ex_cn: 他从事国际商务。
words.en: International business refers to commercial transactions that occur across national borders, including the trade of goods, services, technology, and capital between companies in different countries.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: His thesis is that exercise improves memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点是锻炼能改善记忆力。
words.en: A thesis is a long piece of writing based on your own ideas and research that you do as part of a university degree, especially a higher degree such as a PhD.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: I need to schedule a dissertation tutorial with my advisor.
words.ex_cn: 我需要和我的导师安排一次论文辅导。
words.en: A dissertation tutorial is a session where a student receives guidance on their dissertation from a tutor or advisor.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He is doing report writing for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为科学课写报告。
words.en: Report writing is the process of creating a document that presents information in a structured format, often for business, scientific, or technical purposes. It involves researching, organizing, and presenting data and findings in a clear and concise manner.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.tr: 名词短语。会议报告；研讨会报告；学术会议论文集
words.ex: He read the conference reports last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周读了会议报告。
words.en: Documents or summaries that detail the proceedings, discussions, and outcomes of a conference.

words.tr: phrase. 研究报告；学习报告
words.ex: He wrote a study report about animals.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于动物的学习报告。
words.en: A formal document presenting the findings, analysis, and conclusions from a systematic investigation or research.

words.tr: phrase. 学术报告；学术性书面报告
words.ex: He wrote an academic report for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学课写了一份学术报告。
words.en: A detailed document that presents the findings of a research study or academic inquiry, typically written by students or researchers in an educational institution.

words.ex: The company publishes an annual report every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年发布一份年度报告。
words.en: A document prepared by a company at the end of each year, giving details of its financial performance and activities over the year.

words.ex: If you see anything suspicious, you should report to cop immediately.
words.ex_cn: 如果你看到任何可疑的事情，你应该立即向警察报告。
words.en: To inform the police about something, especially a crime or suspicious activity.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He handed in his written work on time.
words.ex_cn: 他按时交上了他的书面作业。
words.en: A written work is any piece of writing that has been created by an individual or group, often intended for publication or sharing with an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 口头作业；口语练习
words.ex: He does oral work in English class every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在英语课上做口头练习。
words.en: Tasks or activities that involve speaking rather than writing.

words.tr: phrase. 课程作业；学科作业（通常指学生在学期中完成的作业、论文或项目，作为成绩评定的一部分）
words.ex: He finished his course work last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了课程作业。
words.en: Course work refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.tr: phrase. 文献综述；文献回顾
words.ex: He wrote a literature review for his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的研究论文写了一篇文献综述。
words.en: A literature review is a survey of scholarly sources on a specific topic. It provides an overview of current knowledge, allowing you to identify relevant theories, methods, and gaps in the existing research.

words.ex: The study uses a new methodology to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用了一种新的方法论来收集数据。
words.en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

words.tr: phrase. 研究结果；研究发现
words.ex: The scientists shared their research findings with the public.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们将他们的研究发现与公众分享。
words.en: The results or outcomes of a study or investigation.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.ex: The keyword helps you find the right page.
words.ex_cn: 这个关键词帮助你找到正确的页面。
words.en: A word or concept of great significance, especially in the context of information retrieval or search engine optimization.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: Can you summarise the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarise something, you give a summary of it.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr: n. 说明或对白的字幕；副标题；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles for the dialogue.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影为对白提供了英文字幕。
words.en: A subtitle is a secondary or explanatory title, or a translation of the dialogue in a film or television program, displayed at the bottom of the screen.

words.tr: v. 朝向；前进；“head”的现在分词； n. 标题；
words.ex: The ship is heading north.
words.ex_cn: 船正朝北航行。
words.en: A heading is a word, phrase, or sentence at the beginning of a written passage that explains what it's about.

words.ex: The subheading explains the main idea.
words.ex_cn: 副标题解释了主要观点。
words.en: A subheading is a title or a heading that is part of a larger text, usually providing additional information or indicating a subsection.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.ex: The teacher uses simple teaching material for the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生使用简单的教学材料。
words.en: Materials used by a teacher to facilitate learning, including textbooks, workbooks, and digital resources.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr: phrase. 理论背景；指支撑某一研究或观点的理论基础或学术框架
words.ex: We need to understand the theoretical background of this experiment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要了解这个实验的理论背景。
words.en: The knowledge or understanding of the theories and principles that form the basis of a subject or discipline.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr:
n. 目标；目的；
v. 瞄准；以其为目标；
words.ex: His aim is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: An aim is a goal or purpose that you are trying to achieve. It can also refer to the act of directing a weapon or other object towards a target.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 文献综述；文献回顾
words.ex: He wrote a review of literature for his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的研究论文写了一篇文献综述。
words.en: A review of literature is a comprehensive summary of previous research on a topic, which helps to establish the context for new research.

words.ex: He did revision for his math test last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚为数学考试进行了复习。
words.en: The act or process of revising; a revised or new version, as of a book or other written material.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 教学方法；教授方式
words.ex: The teacher uses a new teaching method in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课堂上使用一种新的教学方法。
words.en: A teaching method comprises the principles and methods used by teachers to enable student learning. These strategies are determined partly on subject matter to be taught and partly by the nature of the learner.

words.tr: phrase. 评估方法；评定方式
words.ex: The teacher uses a simple assessment method to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用一种简单的评估方法来检查学生的进步。
words.en: A method or procedure used to evaluate or measure the performance, quality, or nature of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 付款方式；支付方法
words.ex: He chose cash as his payment method.
words.ex_cn: 他选择现金作为支付方式。
words.en: A payment method refers to the way in which a transaction is completed, including cash, credit card, or online payment systems.

words.tr: phrase. 选择方法；挑选方式
words.ex: We need a good selection method for the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要一个好的选择方法来处理这个项目。
words.en: A systematic procedure or criterion used to choose individuals or items from a larger group based on specific requirements.

words.ex: He uses a simple research method to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一种简单的研究方法来收集数据。
words.en: A systematic approach used to collect and analyze data to answer research questions or test hypotheses.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: phrase. 关键方法；主要途径；核心手段
words.ex: The key approach is to practice every day.
words.ex_cn: 关键的方法是每天练习。
words.en: A fundamental or primary method for dealing with a problem or situation.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: The coach changed his tactic to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 教练改变了战术以赢得比赛。
words.en: A tactic is a method or plan chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 参考资料；参考材料；文献资料
words.ex: He uses reference material to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考资料来找到答案。
words.en: Reference material refers to any source of information that is used to support or provide evidence for a particular point or argument. It can include books, articles, databases, and other resources that are consulted during research or study.

words.tr: phrase. 参考文献列表；参考书目；引用清单
words.ex: He checked the reference list for more information.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅了参考文献列表以获取更多信息。
words.en: A reference list is a list of the sources you have cited in your work, allowing readers to locate the original sources.

words.ex: She is a well-organised student who always finishes her homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient or effective way.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 演讲技巧；展示能力；陈述技能
words.ex: He improved his presentation skill by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习提高了演讲技巧。
words.en: The ability to effectively present information to an audience, often used in a professional context to refer to the skills needed to deliver presentations in a clear, engaging, and persuasive manner.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the white board.
words.ex_cn: 老师在白板上写字。
words.en: A white board is a shiny white surface on which you can write and draw with non-permanent markers and then wipe off what you have written or drawn.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；截止日期；预产期
words.ex: The due date for the homework is Friday.
words.ex_cn: 作业的截止日期是星期五。
words.en: The date by which something is expected to happen or be completed.

words.tr: phrase. 应该发生；到期；应得
words.ex: The bus is due in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车五分钟内到达。
words.en: To be required to be returned or paid by a specific date.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.tr: phrase. 字数限制；单词数量上限
words.ex: He forgot the word limit and wrote too much.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了字数限制，写得太多了。
words.en: A maximum number of words allowed in a piece of writing or speech.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.ex: I asked the school for a transcript of my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我向学校要了一份成绩单的副本。
words.en: A transcript is a written or printed version of something that has been recorded or spoken, especially in the context of academic records.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: phrase. 转学学分；指学生从一所教育机构转至另一所时，先前修读课程所获得并被新学校承认的学分
words.ex: He wants to transfer credit from his old school.
words.ex_cn: 他想把以前学校的学分转过来。
words.en: Transfer credit refers to the credits that a student can transfer from one educational institution to another, usually for courses that are equivalent in content and level.

words.tr: phrase. 学分制；信贷系统；信用体系
words.ex: The school uses a credit system to track student progress.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用学分制来跟踪学生的学习进展。
words.en: A credit system is a system that allows people to borrow money or buy goods and services on credit, based on their credit history and ability to repay.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.ex: He took a placement test to join the advanced class.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次分班测试，以便进入高级班。
words.en: A placement test is a test usually given to a student entering an educational institution to determine the level of knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject or subjects.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 考试不及格；未能通过考试
words.ex: He might fail the exam if he does not study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他可能会考试不及格。
words.en: To be unsuccessful in an examination.

words.ex: He felt sad after the failure of his business.
words.ex_cn: 他的生意失败后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The lack of success in achieving or doing something.

words.ex: He will resit the math exam next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将重考数学考试。
words.en: If someone resits an examination, they take it again, usually because they failed it the first time.

words.tr: phrase. 照看；代替；静坐示威；出席
words.ex: Can you sit in while I go to the bathroom?
words.ex_cn: 我去上厕所的时候你能照看一下吗？
words.en: To participate in a sit-in; to occupy seats in a public place as a form of protest.

words.tr: n. 辍学者；退学的人；被淘汰者
words.ex: He became a drop-out after grade 10.
words.ex_cn: 他在十年级后辍学了。
words.en: A person who leaves an educational institution or course before completion.

words.ex: The drop-out rate in this school is high.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的辍学率很高。
words.en: The percentage of students who leave school or a course of study before completing it.

words.ex: He dropped out of the course because it was too hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为课程太难而退课了。
words.en: To withdraw from a course or program of study before completing it.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.tr: n. 欺骗；作弊； v. “cheat”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cheating on the test got him in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 考试中的欺骗让他惹上了麻烦。
words.en: The act of deceiving or tricking someone, especially to gain an advantage in a game or examination.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He will proofread the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送这封信之前会校对。
words.en: To read and mark corrections on a text before it is published.

words.ex: The proofreader meticulously checked the manuscript for errors.
words.ex_cn: 校对者一丝不苟地检查手稿中的错误。
words.en: A proofreader is someone whose job is to check written texts for errors before they are published.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He does data analysis for his job.
words.ex_cn: 他工作做数据分析。
words.en: The process of systematically applying statistical and/or logical techniques to describe and illustrate, condense and recap, and evaluate data.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.ex: The scientist collects data every day.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天收集数据。
words.en: To gather information or statistics systematically for analysis.

words.ex: The statistic shows that 70% of students like math.
words.ex_cn: 这项统计数据表明，70%的学生喜欢数学。
words.en: A statistic is a piece of numerical information obtained from a study of a set of data.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: He learned research methodology in his master's program.
words.ex_cn: 他在硕士课程中学习了研究方法。
words.en: Research methodology refers to the systematic, theoretical analysis of the methods applied to a field of study.

words.tr: phrase. 研究工具；研究手段；用于收集、测量或分析研究数据的设备、问卷、测试或程序
words.ex: The teacher used a survey as a research instrument.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用问卷作为研究工具。
words.en: A tool or device used in conducting research, especially in collecting data.

words.tr: phrase. 研究结果；科研成果
words.ex: The scientist shared the research results with her team.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家与她的团队分享了研究成果。
words.en: The findings or conclusions obtained from a scientific or academic study.

words.tr: phrase. 独立研究；自主研究
words.ex: He did independent research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了关于气候变化的独立研究。
words.en: Independent research refers to a study or investigation that is conducted without external influence or control, often to explore new ideas or validate existing theories.

words.ex: He does scientific research in a lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室做科学研究。
words.en: Scientific research refers to the systematic investigation into and study of materials and sources in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面的面试；当面访谈
words.ex: I have a face-to-face interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天有一个面对面的面试。
words.en: A face-to-face interview is a meeting in which someone is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a job or course.

words.tr: phrase. 电话面试；电话访谈
words.ex: He had a telephone interview yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天进行了一次电话面试。
words.en: A telephone interview is a conversation between a potential employer and a job applicant conducted over the telephone, typically as an initial screening process.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The interviewer asked him about his work experience.
words.ex_cn: 采访者问他关于他的工作经验。
words.en: An interviewer is a person who asks someone questions at an interview.

words.tr: n. 被面试者；被采访者；
words.ex: The interviewee answered all the questions calmly.
words.ex_cn: 被面试者冷静地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A person who is interviewed.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 随机选择；随机抽样
words.ex: The teacher uses random selection to choose a student to answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师用随机选择来挑选一名学生回答问题。
words.en: A method of sampling from a population in which each individual has an equal chance of being selected.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: The headmaster welcomed the new students.
words.ex_cn: 校长欢迎新生。
words.en: A headmaster is the man who is the head teacher of a school.

words.tr: n. 副总裁；副董事长；副总统；副校长
words.ex: He is the vice-president of the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家公司的副总裁。
words.en: A vice-president is an officer in government or business who is next in rank below a president and who takes the president's place when necessary.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: He is an associate professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的副教授。
words.en: An associate professor is a mid-level academic rank in universities and colleges, above assistant professor and below full professor.

words.ex: He is an assistant professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名助理教授。
words.en: An assistant professor is a college or university teacher of the lowest rank, who is working towards becoming a full professor.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
words.ex_cn: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。
words.en: A chancellor is the head of the government in some countries, or a high-ranking official in a university or other institution.

words.ex: He asked his advisor for help with his project.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: An advisor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their financial affairs or about their education.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.tr: phrase. 专业知识；专门知识
words.ex: He has specialist knowledge in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有计算机科学方面的专业知识。
words.en: Specialist knowledge refers to expert understanding or skill in a particular subject or field, often acquired through extensive study or experience.

words.ex: He is a teaching assistant for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他是数学课的助教。
words.en: A teaching assistant is a person who helps a teacher in a classroom, often by providing support to students or helping with the preparation of lessons.

words.ex: He works as an office assistant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司担任办公室助理。
words.en: An office assistant is a person who helps to manage the day-to-day operations of an office, performing tasks such as answering phones, scheduling appointments, and organizing files.

words.tr: phrase. 研究助理；科研助理
words.ex: He works as a research assistant at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里担任研究助理。
words.en: A research assistant is a person employed to help with research, typically in a university or scientific institution.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆助理；图书管理员助理
words.ex: He works as a library assistant at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校担任图书管理员助理。
words.en: A library assistant is a person who helps in the running of a library, performing tasks such as organizing books, helping library users, and managing library resources.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: phrase. 职员；员工；工作人员
words.ex: Every staff member in the company is required to attend the meeting.
words.ex_cn: n. 公司的每一位职员都必须参加会议。
words.en: A staff member is an individual who is employed by an organization to perform specific duties.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: The local paper reported on the recent town hall meeting.
words.ex_cn: 地方报纸报道了最近的市政厅会议。
words.en: A newspaper that focuses on news and events in a specific area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 全国性报纸；国家级文件；官方文件
words.ex: The national paper published an article about the recent political developments.
words.ex_cn: 这家国家级报纸发表了一篇关于最近政治发展的文章。
words.en: A newspaper that is distributed and read throughout a country, often covering national news and issues.

words.ex: He recorded the game on a video tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把比赛录在录像带上。
words.en: A video tape is a magnetic tape used for recording visual images and sound.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: phrase. 期刊论文；学术期刊文章
words.ex: He read a journal article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一篇关于气候变化的期刊文章。
words.en: A journal article is a piece of writing published in a journal or magazine, often presenting the results of research.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 装订成册的卷本；已装订的期刊或书籍合订本
words.ex: He borrowed a bound volume from the library.
words.ex_cn: 他从图书馆借了一本装订好的书。
words.en: A bound volume is a book that contains several issues of a periodical or several pieces of work, bound together in one cover.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 核心教材；关键教科书
words.ex: He uses a key textbook for his math class.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本关键教材学习数学课。
words.en: A fundamental or essential book for study in a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: The library has the latest current issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有这本杂志的最新现期刊物。
words.en: The most recent edition of a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

words.tr: phrase. 过期的期刊；往期杂志
words.ex: He bought a back issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本往期的杂志。
words.en: A back issue refers to a past edition of a magazine, journal, or other periodical that is no longer the current issue.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He uses reference materials to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考资料来找到答案。
words.en: Materials that are used to provide information or evidence, especially for academic or professional research.

words.ex: He uses a reference book to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本参考书来找答案。
words.en: A reference book is a book of facts, such as a dictionary or an encyclopedia, that you look at to find particular information.

words.tr: phrase. 参考资料；参考文献；参考资源
words.ex: He uses reference resources to find the correct answer.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考资料来找到正确答案。
words.en: Materials or sources used for additional information or verification.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: He read a short story before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前读了一个短篇故事。
words.en: A short story is a brief work of fiction, usually written in narrative prose and focusing on a single incident or a series of linked incidents, with the intent of evoking a single effect or mood.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.tr: phrase. 问询处；咨询台；服务台
words.ex: He asked for help at the inquiry desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在问询处寻求帮助。
words.en: A desk or counter in a public place where you can go to ask for information.

words.ex: He returned the book at the delivery desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书台还了书。
words.en: A place in a building where you can collect or arrange for the delivery of items.

words.ex: He returned the book at the circulation desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借还书台归还了这本书。
words.en: The circulation desk is the place in a library where you can borrow and return books.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书区；参考资料部分；文献引用部分
words.ex: He checked the reference section for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考文献区查找那本书。
words.en: The part of a library where reference materials, such as encyclopedias and dictionaries, are kept for in-library use only.

words.ex: He uses a card index to store phone numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用卡片索引来存储电话号码。
words.en: A card index is a system of organizing information on cards, which are stored in a box or cabinet and can be searched through easily.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The library has open shelves for easy access to books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆设有开架书库，方便读者取阅书籍。
words.en: A system in a library where books are placed on open shelves, allowing readers to access them freely without the need for assistance.

words.ex: The library keeps old books on close shelves.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧书放在闭架书库中。
words.en: Shelves that are accessible or not locked, often in a library or store.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.tr: phrase. 参考栈；引用栈（计算机术语，指用于存储函数调用、变量引用或调试信息的内存区域）
words.ex: He checked the reference stack for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考书架查找那本书。
words.en: A set of standard or benchmark materials used for comparison.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.ex: He looked at the catalogue to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalogue is a list of things such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.tr: phrase. 返回区域；回收区；退货区
words.ex: The return area is near the exit door.
words.ex_cn: 返回区域在出口门附近。
words.en: The designated section in a library or store where customers can bring back borrowed or purchased items.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.ex: The school has a well-equipped audio-visual resource centre.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个设备齐全的视听资源中心。
words.en: A place where audio and visual materials are stored and made available for use, typically in an educational or institutional setting.

words.ex: He went to the photocopy room to make a copy of his paper.
words.ex_cn: 他去复印室复印了他的论文。
words.en: A room equipped with photocopiers for making copies of documents.

words.ex: The photocopier broke down this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这台复印机今天早上坏了。
words.en: A photocopier is a machine that makes copies of documents or pictures by photographing them.

words.ex: He uses the copy machine to make papers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用复印机来复印纸张。
words.en: A machine that makes copies of documents and other visual images quickly and cheaply.

words.ex: The copier is broken, so we can't make copies.
words.ex_cn: 复印机坏了，所以我们不能复印了。
words.en: A copier is a machine that makes paper copies of documents and other visual images quickly and cheaply.

words.ex: He uses a color copier to print his pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他使用彩色复印机打印他的照片。
words.en: A machine that makes copies of documents or images in color.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: He uses a scanner to copy documents.
words.ex_cn: 他使用扫描仪来复制文件。
words.en: A scanner is a device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆馆际互借服务
words.ex: The library offers an interlibrary service to borrow books from other libraries.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆提供馆际服务，可以从其他图书馆借书。
words.en: A service allowing libraries to borrow materials from other libraries on behalf of their patrons.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网接入；上网权限；网络连接
words.ex: He has internet access at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家有网络访问。
words.en: The ability to connect to the internet, allowing users to browse websites, send emails, and use online services.

words.ex: The digital system shows the time on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个数字系统在屏幕上显示时间。
words.en: A digital system is a system that uses discrete values, often binary numbers, for input, processing, transmission, storage, or display, as opposed to an analog system which uses continuous signals.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机终端，一种用于输入和输出数据的电子设备，通常连接到主机或服务器
